text: Implemented BoundSchedule as the sole admission of Compiled schedule plus exact SampleId axis, axis-derived Resample4s SourceIdentity, design-derived label authority, named seed authority, and freshly generated PlanReceipt. The raw Compiled/Plan is not exposed; unit access binds authoritative SampleIds through kind-preserving ReindexingLegs and typed selection/draw splits. Courts cover selection, injection, draw occurrence/multiplicity, permutation, receipt equality, unknown population, foreign label digest, seed mismatch, population mismatch, and compile-time nominal-axis separation. Focused tests passed 4/4 on JVM and 4/4 on Scala.js; diff-check and escape-hatch audit clean.
